items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you come with Benny Morton to New York? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, (inaudible).

ctx.x: John brought him, oh. John brought Willard out. Well, let me see now. So that's between '35 and '36. Benny Morton died in '35 and you came to New York in '36. Well, Bill, I'm going to have to ask you a sticky question.
